Variants.Content: Entry Located on the western shore of the Narrow Sea, Pentos is a free-trading city-state known for its brick walls, port, plains hinterland, and wealthy merchants' mansions. The city was ostensibly ruled by princes, but actual power had long flowed between governors, merchants, and wealthy families; the princes were more likely to be associated with rituals Pentos thrived on trade, horses, spices, wool, and cross-sea commerce. It was also deeply involved in the tradition of the slave trade. Even if the system changes publicly, old interests and prejudices will not disappear immediately. It's close to Westeros, so it always hears earlier about the exiles, wars, and betrothals of the dynasty on the other side.
